1ac304092474756d.title: Advancing aging biomarkers and intervention discovery at the TimePie Longevity Forum
digest: On 20–21 September 2025, the 6th TimePie Longevity Forum convened approximately 2,500 participants from 16 countries in Shanghai.
Attendees spanned aging biology, biomarker development and clinical geroscience.

9137db683413d84e.title: Decline of chaperone-mediated autophagy in aging impairs macrophage clearance of senescent cells
digest: This study looks at how the decline in chaperone-mediated autophagy in aging alters senescent cell properties leading to an impairment in their immune clearance.
Utilizing proteomic and metabolomic analyses, the authors show that restoring autophagy enhances macrophage function and reduces senescent cell accumulation.

b821a566ee0bbb3e.title: ResolVI: addressing noise and bias in spatial transcriptomics
digest: Segmentation and quantification of spatial transcriptomics data is plagued by specific noise and bias.
ResolVI tackles this challenge by generating error- and batch-corrected probabilistic representations of spatial transcriptomics data, contributing to improved performance in multiple analysis tasks.

04ec2dafabeaaf1e.title: Mitochondrial membrane lipid cardiolipin controls fiber-type adaptations in aging muscle via estrogen-related receptor γ
digest: report that declining synthesis of the mitochondrial membrane lipid cardiolipin is a feature of aging in mouse and human skeletal muscle, driving age-related fiber-type and metabolic adaptations through mitochondria-to-nucleus communication.

7a44e8b6bb19238c.title: CytoVI: deep generative modeling of antibody-based single cell data

digest: Spatial Hi-C allows the study of chromatin organization in a spatially resolved manner.

e8bf10d426f63223.title: AI-guided optimization for thermostable mRNA vaccines
digest: AGENT, an AI-driven framework integrating high-throughput experimentation with Bayesian optimization, enables the rapid engineering of thermostable, solid-state mRNA vaccines.

These formulations retained full bioactivity after storage at 37 °C for 2 months, elicited immune responses non-inferior to fresh vaccines, and enabled cold-chain-free delivery via microneedle patches in rodents and nonhuman primates.
